kai (SEO): quick thread — final SEO smoke tests for launch + webinar. focus: schema validation, redirect smoke tests, anchor text hygiene.

rana (PMM): i have hero H1 + ad keyword list. i'll paste into the content doc and flag primary intent.

omar (Web): i'll run a redirect smoke script on staging and push nginx 301 rules. sample rule:```nginx
location = /old-webinar { return 301 https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/prod-inference; }
```

lucy (Growth): ensure hubspot form receives utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=prod_launch and a hidden campaign_id field for last-touch mapping.

kai (SEO): schema snippets to include: Event, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList. small inline sample for validation:```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Prod LLM Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/prod-inference"}```

omar (Web): quick title rule: if a supporting page title collides with hero, append " — Redwood Inference" suffix to keep titles unique. i'll add to the CMS template.

seo-bot: Staging crawl scheduled 2026-05-03T06:00:00Z — will report 301s, 302s, 404s, duplicate titles, and meta length warnings.

kai (SEO): compact preflight checklist:
- keyword map assigned per page
- JSON-LD validated and injected into CMS head
- 301 redirect rules tested on staging
- canonical tags present and authoritative on hero
- sitemap updated and submitted to Search Console
- CTAs include UTM + campaign_id -> HubSpot mapping
- internal anchor map added to content doc
- staging crawl green from seo-bot

rana (PMM): timeline: drafts by 2026-04-21, dev PRs 04-23, staging QA 04-24, deploy 04-29, webinar 05-12.

omar (Web): i'll post the redirect PR after smoke tests, aiming for review today.

kai (SEO): thanks team — paste final JSON-LD snippets into CMS head and keep the content doc updated. :rocket:
